_comment: Keys ON in the previous release but deliberately not ON in master defaults (tools/release-defaults-check.ts). Each needs a reason. ini keys are Section.Key, tuning keys kName.

exceptions.reason: v0.3.0: v0.2.12 shipped DirectLeaf=1 with [MonoJit] Enabled=0 (no effect). With the compiler on, 0 is the tested default: lazy bodies (BoundCall, ClauseLazy, CallExit) need DirectLeaf=0 for a callee with calls (ini comments, release plan N1, jit-bundle-verify-1113).
v0.3.0: 4 -> 7 adds bits 0+1 (cache warm-up after a world load + unchanged check) to the shipped bit 2; bit 2 stays on (Rodney 2026-11-13, release plan N11). Not a value drop.

v0.3.2: 250 -> 0 with [RouteAsync] Kinds=2 (routableasync, PR #589 family): a cut routableasync job answers not routable and SpotVerdict caches that cell for a sim-day, so own PlanFromPoint jobs are never cut (docs/584 §3). Not a feature drop.
v0.3.2: v0.3.0 and v0.3.1 shipped -1 (off, privacy-door wrong answer); master 3 after the fix (docs/585 §9, DoorMemoX verify). -1 reads as non-zero here; it was off in the release.
v0.3.2: 8192 -> 12288, a larger compiled-code table (raised, not dropped).
